source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
When the battle ends, the player with more VP wins; equal VP is a draw.

Each source has a VP cap, and VP above it are ignored:

- **PRIMARY MISSION**: **45VP**, at most **15VP** per battle round.
- **SECONDARY MISSIONS**: **45VP**, at most **15VP** per battle round and **20VP** from each Fixed Secondary Mission card.
- **BATTLE READY ARMY**: **10VP**, scored for an army painted to Battle Ready standard.
